span.p:
Write path:
1. Client sends write to TAO leader
2. Leader updates MySQL database
3. Leader writes new value to local cache
4. Leader responds to client
5. Leader asynchronously propagates write to followers

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 110px; text-align: center; width: 110px;

span.p:
Read path:
1. Client reads from nearest TAO follower
2. Follower has fresh data from leader propagation
3. If miss: follower queries MySQL replica

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 110px; text-align: center; width: 110px;

span.p:
Key insight: write-through with leader-based invalidation
eliminates the stale-read window for the writing client.
